The trigonal phase Cr2Co32Mo2O60 (CrCo16MoO30) crystallizes in space group R-3m (No. 119) with 96 atoms per unit cell distributed over 11 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Cr and Mo centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Co centers also exhibit octahedral O coordination with additional 9- and 12-vertex environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Co octahedra and between Cr and Co octahedra, while Co octahedra show edge-sharing with Co 9-vertex polyhedra and face-sharing with Mo octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
